title: Rideshare Booking, Fare Estimator & Live Driver Tracking
name: Rideshare Booking, Fare Estimator & Live Driver Tracking
user_prompt: Build a rideshare passenger booking and live driver-dispatch web app in Los Angeles. Pre-seed pickup and drop-off locations with Places Autocomplete inputs so a trip renders immediately on load. Use the Routes API to compute and compare both the fastest traffic-aware route and the Eco-Friendly route on the map, calculating transparent Economy, Comfort, and Green fare estimates from real trip duration and distance while highlighting fuel/energy savings. Simulate dispatching the closest driver from nearby candidate vehicles and smoothly animate the driver's custom Advanced Marker along the pickup and trip polyline with live ETA updates.
